name: Felix Holm
headline: Data Scientist
summary: Data scientist with a strong background in analytical modeling, applied statistics, and production-focused experimentation. Brings experience working across business-facing teams to improve forecasting, classification, and reporting workflows. Known for turning messy operational data into practical tools and clear decision support.
